_comment: Our own text entries, added to every language's msg/<lang>/menu_dlc01.msgbnd.dcx by scripts/build-gamedata.ps1. Keys are FMG file names inside that bundle; ids are in our range 99100000..99199999 (UI-0/UI-1). English in every language for now.

CL_MenuText_dlc01.131153:
Rival teams. One victor.

Defeat the other teams, take what they drop and outlast them all: the last team standing wins. Day 1 is free of the Night's Tide, so make it count; from Day 2 the Tide closes in.
CL_MenuText_dlc01.131155:
Face to face. Best of three.

Straight into Heolstor's arena with the build you chose at the Sparring Grounds. Win two rounds to take the match.
